ModMetaData.name: Wraith & Nanite Gravtech
ModMetaData.author: Vardath
ModMetaData.description: Clean RimWorld 1.6 rebuild of Wraith & Nanite Gravtech: Wraith life-force biology and living technology, modular Replicators and human-form nanite synthetics, distinct Wraith and Asuran gravship families, four usable Odyssey craft, faction progression, archaeology and optional Stargate/ONAC/RimGate interoperability.
